risk_note: RV2 (settlement rebate path; no booking). FU-R6-VERSION-ROW (orchestrator D10-931 ①, D10-932; BR-CALC-15 / B2-03q 'version >= 1 always has amount rows'). Reproduced on main 782fdcd54 with a throwaway probe: an unsettled jd order (ESTIMATED / WAITING, v1 with rows) receiving one report mapped to PLATFORM_INVALID while its estimate moves (1000 -> 0 or -> 600) ended VOID with commission_version 2 but amount rows and four amounts only for v1. Root cause: rebate.ts decideUpdate's reverse branch advanced and returned without refresh; advancing to a VOID with a reason clears refresh. Fix: one line after advance in that branch, `if (change.commission_moved === true) d.refresh = true;` (mirror of BASE_ZERO); R6 still books nothing; PUNISH shares the branch (no status map code reaches it today). Out of scope per D10-932: orders imported already invalid with no estimate (P13, frozen flow.int.test.ts). Local container slot: rule tests 5/5, spec/settlement/rebate 92/92, spec/orders/rebate-wiring 24/24, rebate unit tests 14/14; the probe's regression over spec/settlement, spec/orders and spec/commission was also green. Full verification by the required CI checks.
